title: Flagship of Watersound | Luxurious 30A Villa | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Flagship of Watersound is a luxury 30A retreat with private pool, carriage house, bikes, Gulf views, and space for families near the beach.
description_expanded: Flagship of Watersound Features: • Private pool (heated for an additional fee from October through April) • Enjoy four cruiser-style bicycles; exploring Watersound by bike is highly recommended • One-minute bike ride to beach access on Shingle Lane • Two-minute bike ride to the Dunesider community pool (heated during cooler months) • One-minute walk to Puttering Park, with a mini-golf course • Three-minute bike ride to The Big Chill, with numerous dining options, live music, bingo night, trivia night, and game day events on a projector screen • Separate carriage house apartment with kitchenette, living room, dining area, laundry closet, queen suite, and queen sleeper sofa (private entrance above the garage) • Dining room with seating for eight, plus breakfast bar seating for four • Outdoor gas grill next to the private pool • Wireless internet throughout the main home and carriage house • Washer and dryer located on the first floor • Roku televisions with streaming services and YouTube TV (including live and local channels) • Driveway parking for up to three vehicles • Second-floor entertainment lounge • Covered porch with seating • Screened-in porch with dining area • Second-floor sundeck with lounge seating • Third-floor card room with Gulf views (also functions as a private workspace) • Concierge services available, including beach setup, grocery delivery, bike rentals, and private chef services • Please note: Access to Watersound Beach Club is not included with your reservation • Golf cart rentals are not allowed in Watersound due to homeowners association regulations Welcome to the Flagship of Watersound! Boasting stylish interiors, luxury amenities, and Gulf views, this gorgeous home is perfect for large or multiple families looking to vacation in style. Located in serene Watersound-home to some of the most beautiful beaches along Scenic Highway 30A-the Flagship of Watersound offers spacious interiors and inviting outdoor spaces. The main living area greets you upon entry and flows seamlessly into the formal dining area and a fully equipped kitchen. Watch the game on the large SmartTV or snuggle up for a cozy family movie night. The dining area includes seating for eight, with additional space at the nearby breakfast bar. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances, a Sub-Zero refrigerator with a beverage drawer, and everything needed to serve your entire group. On the second floor, an entertainment lounge includes a plush sleeper sofa and large-screen television-ideal for a kids' movie night upstairs while the adults enjoy the main living spaces. For game lovers, the third-floor game room includes a card table and Gulf views, perfect for family poker night or as a private workspace. The adjacent carriage house is ideal for in-laws or guests. This fully equipped apartment includes a living room with a SmartTV, dining area with seating for four, kitchenette with a microwave, refrigerator, and coffee maker, as well as a queen suite with a full bathroom. An additional guest may sleep comfortably on the sleeper sofa.
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor King Guest Room | TV; across from hallway access to full bathroom
2nd Floor King Deluxe Suite | Walk-in closet, TV, ensuite bathroom
2nd Floor Bunk Room | Double-over-double bunk bed with twin trundle (sleeps up to 3); television; hallway access to full bathroom
2nd Floor Queen Suite | TV; ensuite bathroom
Carriage House Queen Suite | Includes full bathroom, kitchenette, dining area, and living room with a Smart TV
Bonus Sleeping Options | Queen sleeper sofa in the carriage house and queen sleeper sofa in the second-floor entertainment lounge of the main house

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
